articles.summary: A new study by Biobot Analytics and Mathematica, in partnership with the Washington/Baltimore High Intensity Drug Trafficking Area (W/B HIDTA), reveals the power of wastewater data in addressing the drug epidemic. Cambridge, Mass – April 30, 2024 – Wastewater monitoring is an effective tool in detecting emerging opioid threats, predicting overdoses, and tailoring treatments, according […]
articles.title: Wastewater Data Offers Powerful Tool in Confronting Opioid Epidemic, New Study Reveals
